title: Two-thirds, i
logline: Monday. The parody's week is over. Drift Wood returns, and Wood is drawn at two-thirds his usual size. Gully, normal. The counter, normal. Nobody remarks. The strip will hold this for six weeks.

panels.composition: Gully's. WOOD on the end stool — small. The stool is normal. His feet don't reach the rung. GULLY, normal. BARNABY, normal.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with saturated neon monitor glow cutting through a dark garage, jagged hyperactive linework, muddy digital flats, a bait-shop counter where a thin man sits on the end stool drawn at two-thirds normal size so his feet do not reach the rung, a normal-sized man in an apron and a normal-sized dog
image.notes: Wood at two-thirds. Everything else exact. No remark, ever.

panels.composition: The coffee mug. In Wood's hands it's a bowl.
